title: E-Waste Detection and Recycling Quality Controller

test_results.note: Partly inflated: it trained on copies of some test images

9.5M parameters vs 2.5M; 3.6 ms per image vs 1.9 ms. +1.2 mAP50 for ~2x slower inference
Same as v2 overall. Better: Microwave, Dishwasher, Oven, Printer. Worse: Flat-Panel-TV, Stove, Toaster
Highest mAP50-95. Flips/rescales each test image and merges results; 8.4 ms per image instead of 3.6 ms
Best plain model. 20.4M parameters, 8.7 ms per image (4.6x slower than YOLO26n)
